title: Assemble intro
summary: For trades, products, anything put together: the headline letters fly in from scattered places and lock together on a firm spring.

title: Develop intro
summary: For people, portraits, coaches, photographers: the subject develops like a photograph (blur, grey and bright to sharp and full color).

title: Pour intro
summary: For food, drink, anything you fill: the letters drop in left to right like something poured, settling as they land.

title: Unfold intro
summary: For editorial, studios, salons: the words unfold upward from their baseline like a turned page.

title: Type intro
summary: For software, writing, digital products: the headline is typed out letter by letter with a caret.

title: Mask intro
summary: For quiet confidence, editorial: the words rise out of their own baseline as if from behind a rule.

title: Stamp intro
summary: For posters, tickets, labels, events: each word is pressed onto the page a beat apart, like type in a press.

title: Draw intro
summary: For anything drawn in line, architects, makers: the words settle from wide to their own width.

title: Scroll scrub
summary: The section's pieces move with the scroll, in order, and back when scrolling up.

title: Scroll pin
summary: The section holds on screen while its pieces step through one by one.

title: Scroll scene
summary: The section changes scene as it crosses the screen: its pieces move at their own depth and turn.

title: Alive at rest
summary: Cards and images that drift, lean toward the pointer, spring when tapped and tilt with the scroll.

title: Reveal kit
summary: Reveal on scroll, words that rise, parallax, a magnetic button, a spotlight card, a ticking number and a reading bar. About 3 KB.

title: Liquid chrome
summary: A liquid-metal background that warps under the pointer (WebGL1, every phone).

title: Particle swarm
summary: A swarm that forms your word, logo or image from a scatter, scrubbed by scroll.

title: Activity rings
summary: Progress rings that draw in turn, count up, and lap past 100%.

title: Stacked toasts
summary: Notifications that stack, fan out on hover and swipe away.

title: Bottom sheet
summary: A drag-to-close sheet with snap points, on a native dialog.
